about_the_game:
World of Eggs: Idle Adventures Demo is a unique adventure in the style of global strategy, where you build your own civilization, trade with other players, fight in raids, and the game runs in a fully idle mode.

All the routine — gathering, crafting, resource distribution — is automated so you can focus on strategy, development, and collecting.

With one click, launch processes that continue even while you are offline. Build your economy, plan interactions with other players, and send your armies to hunt for unique rewards. World of Eggs: Idle Adventures Demo combines familiar elements of strategy with an innovative idle progression system.

In the demo version you will find:

Player economy: build trade chains, rent items, and use the market to grow your wealth.

Process automation: crafting, resource gathering, and army development work even without your involvement.

Item rental system: new opportunities for player interaction.

Over 50 unique units: each with its own role and characteristics.

More than 100 unique items: resources, artifacts, and collectibles.

A fully idle game: for those who value strategy and progress rather than clicking buttons.

World of Eggs: Idle Adventures Demo is an exciting idle adventure that appeals both to newcomers to idle games and to experienced strategists. Every effort influences your progress: investments in the economy strengthen the army, resource gathering opens new horizons, and raids harden you and bring unique rewards.

Will you be able to build the greatest civilization in the world of eggs?
